title: DepRisk doctor report (v1)
description: Output of 'deprisk doctor --format json': facts about this installation (version, runtime, platform, the reachability analyzer, the audit store and its signing key, configuration). Unlike the analysis outputs it is NOT deterministic across machines: the details contain paths and the platform of the machine it ran on. The details never contain a passphrase. The exit code is 0 whatever the warnings.

checks.description: One entry per check, in the order of the table. Check names: version, runtime, platform, deprisk-reach, deprisk-kernel, audit, audit-key (only in an initialized project), config.

status.description: ok: as expected. info: not present, and that is fine. warn: something that would stop or weaken a command.

warnings.description: The number of checks with the status warn.
